name: My work lists
tagline: PRs, reviews and issues that involve you
summary: Three cross-repository lists: Pull requests, Reviews and Issues that involve you, grouped by your role. Search, filter, sort, and act on many rows at once.

flow.label: Pull requests page
flow.note: /pulls reads the 'my pulls' query and renders one collapsible group per role.

flow.label: getMyPulls
flow.note: Resolves the viewer, runs the multi-source search and filters the result by App access.

flow.label: searchEverySource
flow.note: One search per installation plus an OAuth fallback, 18 s total budget, newest copy wins.

flow.label: GitHub GraphQL search
flow.note: One query per source returns up to 30 open items for each role.

flow.label: useListFilters
flow.note: Keeps search, filters and sort in the URL and restores the last view from a cookie.

flow.label: BulkSelection
flow.note: Row checkboxes feed a floating bar that reviews, runs and reports the chosen action.

features.name: Role-grouped lists
features.summary: Pull requests in five groups, issues in three (assigned, authored, mentioned), and Reviews as the review-requested group on its own.

features.name: Multi-source search
features.summary: Each installation and the OAuth token search with their own rate limit. A blocked or slow source gives a partial result and a warning.

features.name: Filters, sort and search
features.summary: Status, author, label, repository and updated-within filters with 'is' and 'is not', five sort orders, and text search. Phones get drawers.

features.name: Remembered view
features.summary: Filters live in the URL as 'status:open,draft|author!:nova'. The 'diffkit-filters' cookie restores the last view when a list opens without any.

features.name: Row selection
features.summary: Checkboxes on hover, X to toggle, Shift+click for a range, Cmd/Ctrl+A for every visible row, Esc to clear. Desktop widths only.

features.name: Floating action bar
features.summary: Merge, close or reopen pull requests; close with a reason or reopen issues. It shows what is skipped, runs one by one and keeps failures to retry.

features.name: Row design
features.summary: One shared row: state icon, number, title with diff stat, label and repository pills, comment count, then aligned avatar and time columns.
